name: Cury Construtora e Incorporadora S.A.
summary: Cury Construtora e Incorporadora S.A. operates in real estate businesses in Brazil. The company engages in selling real estate units; credit analysis services; residential real estate developments; rental of own properties; and provision of services relating to construction, supervision, studies, and projects, in addition to the execution of any construction works and civil engineering. It also provides construction, management, real estate administration, and electrical and hydraulic installation services. The company was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil.
